mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls by more than 2% YoY and HOUST declines by more than 10% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) that falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE is below 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of four consecutive months of INDPRO declines exceeding 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in CPIAUCSL of more than 0.5% and a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% for two consecutive months signals a deflationary monetary regime, which increases real discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change < -0.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL falls by more than 0.5% monthly and FEDFUNDS is below 3% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) of more than 5% alongside a concurrent decline in personal income growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% monthly) signals a shift from spending to saving, which reduces aggregate demand and corporate sales, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS monthly change > 5% AND PAYEMS monthly change < 0.2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during months where RSAFS rises by more than 5% and PAYEMS growth is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% for three consecutive months signals a deepening labor market slack, which reduces consumer purchasing power and corporate hiring, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of three consecutive months with UNRATE above 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1% combined with a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) of more than 15% signals a broad-based demand collapse, which directly reduces corporate revenues and triggers equity repricing, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ change < 1% AND HOUST monthly change < -15%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during quarters where GDPC1 grows below 1% QoQ and HOUST declines by more than 15% monthly.
